facts.rationale: States exact comparisons and exceptional branches without guaranteeing capsule inactivity or eventual countdown expiry.
facts.value: Only a previously positive countdown is reduced by frame_speed_mul. If the result is <=0 and cur_anim_frame is strictly below attackairlw_hit_anim_frame_end, capsule indices 0, 1 and 2 receive the indexed helper operations. The countdown is not clamped; zero speed stalls it and negative speed increases it. Initially nonpositive countdowns and expiry at or after the end frame perform no local capsule restoration. Common aerial animation runs in every case and may reverse facing or enter Fall.

evidence.why: Entry, hit response, restart and conditional restoration.
Engine contains animation-callback replacement and damage-callback clearing.

facts.rationale: Preserves configured values, restoration guards and the cross-file callback-lifetime boundary.
facts.value: Down-aerial entry installs custom callbacks and initializes a zero countdown. The hit callback invokes all-capsule collision cleanup, assigns data-configured vertical velocity, clears fast-fall, stores the configured start value, and conditionally restarts AttackAirLw at end-minus-start. While the custom animation callback is active, a positive countdown crossing to <=0 restores three indexed capsules only before the configured end frame, then common animation processing runs. The restart path does not reinstall the custom callbacks locally; their survival across engine state changes must not be assumed.
